title: Write features/daw/clip-folder.feature and its steps (shared STEPS.md); watch them fail
description:
## Intent

Specs first for the browsable clip folder.

## Scope

- `features/daw/clip-folder.feature` with every scenario of the stories apricitus-3848a7, apricitus-65f688, apricitus-92a3ab and apricitus-2e3f63.
- New steps in the shared `features/daw/STEPS.md` (the sidecar and set-export initiatives add theirs to the same file; reuse their steps for reading an `.alc` and for building manifests with saved clips, apricitus-745a53, rather than defining a second set): building a sample's manifest with given sections, loops, shots and tags on a synthetic beat grid; listing a folder; "references" and "loops" checks on an `.alc`.
- Manifests written by steps are validated against `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json`, so fixtures cannot drift from the contract.
- Tiny WAVs generated per scenario; no audio in git.

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
Scenarios fail for the right reason (no `--clips`); output in a comment.

## Release

`test(<this task id>): specs for the clip folder`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M0's decisions (apricitus-e286ad) and the crate skeleton (apricitus-57dc3f, or apricitus-6f37e1 if the set export lands first).
